consumer: The find-item quest's possession gate, i.e. the dialogue/condition has_items check (set_has_items in condition.cpp), asking 'does the character possess flashlight?' as a yes/no the engine condition evaluates.
scope: Only the character's own carried items (the actor's possession via has_charges/has_amount), not nearby or reachable inventory.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items builds the u_has_items/npc_has_items lambda that returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor — the engine-computed possession predicate whose returned value is the authority.
divergence: A flashlight stored inside a worn closed backpack: the engine possession predicate (has_amount/has_charges) counts it as possessed and the gate passes, but a re-derivation from the snapshot's top-level carried_items[] enumeration reports false — exposing a wrong answer.
